name: Real-Time Chat App
description: A MERN-based chat application supporting real-time messaging using Socket.io. Includes user authentication, private/public chat rooms, and stores messages in MongoDB for persistent and secure communication between users.

name: Password Manager
description: A secure password manager built with the MERN stack. It encrypts and stores user credentials, features login/signup, and allows users to manage and generate strong passwords efficiently.

name: Spotify UI Clone
description: A visually accurate Spotify user interface clone built using React and Node.js. Displays playlists, album art, and audio controls with responsive design, mimicking Spotify's modern and sleek layout.

name: Chatbot with Gemini API
description: An AI-powered chatbot using the Gemini API integrated into a MERN stack. Users can interact in real-time, with intelligent responses generated and stored for improved conversational context.
